usedFor: Shopify takes the orders, and Vonage texts the buyer when “Order Paid” runs “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Send SMS” in Vonage
bestTemplate.why: A paid order sends a text confirmation to the buyer, through your Vonage account.

watchOut: “Send SMS” needs a phone number, so the order must carry one.
